answer: Each agent identity must periodically present verifiable benchmark receipts: proof it ran work tasks, checked by independent measurers. Like an oasis in a desert of cheap claims, a valid receipt is the only water that counts, and without one there are no earnings. Receipts are carved into the ledger like marble, tamper-evident and public, so a Sybil farmer cannot reuse one receipt across identities. Work is arranged as a trellis, each new task building on verified prior work, so faking a history means redoing the whole lattice. A thousand fake agents means paying for a thousand real workloads.
